newEvents.event: Our office followed up with AAA after calls to the adjuster went unanswered; AAA acknowledged receiving the demand package, and the homeowner contacted AAA directly to request a callback.
Our office confirmed AAA had not yet named an appraiser, so Joseph could not attend the carrier's reinspection, and asked the contractor to attend in his place.
Our office followed up on the carrier's inspection results; the contractor confirmed an engineer's inspection was scheduled for August 31 and shared the report AAA had sent.
Our office followed up on the results of the August 31 engineer inspection; the homeowner reported nothing had come back yet.
Our office followed up with AAA again, noting 26 days had passed since the demand letter with no appraiser named, and requested a status update.

results.update: AAA has confirmed it received our demand package and an engineer inspected the property August 31, but results haven't come back yet, and as of September 7 AAA still hasn't named an appraiser. We're pressing the carrier for both the engineer's findings and an appraiser assignment.
results.notes: Three threads (1a07d511..., 1a07d4ec..., 1a07d412...) were internal staff call-list roundups covering 24 unrelated files, not case correspondence — they only confirm this file's claim number/demand date, already reflected in the 2026-09-07 event, so no separate events were pulled from them. All other threads were genuinely about this insured/claim (017936054, 7027 Isle Royale Lane) — none dropped for wrong-person mismatch.
